text:
Rafi: Morning discovery: someone slid a tiny nameplate into the office fern pot. It now has a title. :seedling: 
Nora: what DOES the fern do? important governance question.
Doorman Dan: Officially endorsing the Fern as a full employee. Title suggestion: 'Fern Ambassador for Low-Light Diplomacy'.
Elena: love it. Can we make a tiny proclamation and a sash? Also, who will be the Fern's human trustee?
Rafi: I nominate morning-shift waterer. Responsibilities: whisper encouragements and rotate slightly.
Tess: ops-bot, low-effort poll please: Sash color - Forest Green / Pastel Purple / Plaid.
ops-bot: Poll created: "Fern Ambassador sash color" Options: Forest Green / Pastel Purple / Plaid. React to vote.
Nora: voted Pastel Purple because optical morale. :purple_heart:
Tess: voted Forest Green. :evergreen_tree:
Doorman Dan: voted Plaid - it signals commitment. :plaid: (not a real emoji)
Elena: drafting proclamation text for onboarding card. quick version:
```
Proclamation of the Fern Ambassador
- Office fern granted ambassador status effective immediately.
- Trustee assigned: morning-shift waterer (1x water, gentle spin weekly).
- Duties: absorb low moods, collect small post-its, and judge plant puns.
- Violations: overwatering = detention (name quarantine).
```
Rafi: adding a clause: if the fern blooms, free pastries for all. Fair? :crossed_fingers:
Tess: obviously fair.
Nora: also adding a small laminated card for the plant: "If in doubt, talk to the Fern."
Elena: snapping a pic and uploading to #random-photos. https://files.redwood/fern_ambassador.jpg
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Fern Ambassador sash poll closes in 24h". :bell:
Rafi: ok this is officially a lore seed. Will include in the next 'culture crumbs' doc for new hires.
Tess: side challenge: best fern pun in 24h gets a sticker. Game on.
Doorman Dan: I will judge. Expect impartial granola-fueled decisions.
Nora: my entry: "Fern-tastic leadership." you're welcome.
Elena: mine: "In a world of succulents, be a fern"
ops-bot: Poll closing reminder scheduled. :alarm_clock:
